name: PR fix
notes: d21, d30: quiet period -> GitGuardian hold (d25: no fix while it fails on the head) -> trusted review threads and the failing SonarCloud conditions -> one try: the fixer of its level -> test gate. #39, #56: the try's fixer (the dispatch's level; none: qwen-fixer) picks the agent step: agent_claude (level 1) or agent_codex (level 3) on spark, each with its own hand-off carrying its commits to spark2, or agent_qwen (level 2) on spark2; select hands the one that ran to the single gate. Builds and gates one commit; never reviews or pushes it. pr-fixer-review-commit fires on its success with a passing gate and has it reviewed; a gate that does not pass ends the run with its verdict and instruction (gate_instruction), and pr-fixer-retry puts the PR back in the queue (#35).

steps.name: Quiet period
steps.notes: Wait 5 minutes; if the PR head moved meanwhile the run ends superseded.

steps.name: Hold while GitGuardian fails
steps.notes: d25: reads the GitGuardian check of the PR head as the App and fails the run (secrets_found) while it fails: a leaked secret is revoked and rotated by a human, never edited by the agent. pr-fixer-secrets posts the findings. Fails closed on a lookup error.

steps.name: Trusted review threads
steps.notes: Lists the PR's unresolved review threads as the App and keeps those opened by an author in trusted_authors. Fails the run on any lookup error (no list is handed on).

steps.name: Failing SonarCloud conditions
steps.notes: The built-in sonar.gate_issues: the PR's SonarCloud quality gate and only the issues behind its failing conditions (never the project's backlog), with a note for the agent. Advisory: a failed lookup is available false, never a failed run.

body.name: Fix the PR (Qwen bridge agent)
body.notes: Level 2 (#56; #39: when the try's fixer is qwen-fixer, or none is given: without fixer_levels every try is Qwen's). The cultureagent bridge checks out head_sha in a fresh worktree on spark2 and runs the agent with the instruction and the bound inputs: the trusted, unresolved threads and the issues behind the PR's failing SonarCloud conditions. The agent commits locally and never pushes. require_commit: a turn that leaves no commit fails the step at once (no_changes), so the attempt ends before any gate or review and hands back once.

body.name: Fix the PR (Claude bridge agent)
body.notes: Level 1 (#56: when the try's fixer is claude-fixer). The cultureagent claude bridge on spark, as its own unprivileged account (culture-claude-fixer, its own claude login), checks out head_sha in a fresh worktree and runs Claude Code with the instruction and the same bound inputs; it commits locally and never pushes. require_commit as for agent_qwen. Its commits reach spark2's gate only through its own hand-off (handoff_export_claude, handoff_import_claude), so select labels them claude-fixer.

body.notes: #56: packs the Claude fixer's commits (head_before..head_after) out of its worktree on spark, as its account (run_as culture-claude-fixer), into one size-capped store document (handoff_too_large over the cap: the try fails).

steps.name: Fix and test, one try
steps.notes: One try (d30): the agent of the try's level (#39, #56: agent_qwen, or agent_claude or agent_codex and its own hand-off), then the gate. The try ends when the gate has given its verdict, whatever it is; a try that does not pass waits in the queue for the next one.
